rules.statement: A trial judge must consider and answer the issues raised by the parties in a partition case, and must not fail to do so under the guise of not considering documents that were not tendered with the written submissions.
rules.supporting_quote: It is the very basic point in writing a judgment. It is so important that it is the accepted procedure that when issues are raised, the pleadings go to the background and the case is heard based on the points of contest meaning the issues raised by parties after putting down the admissions.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 187 of the Civil Procedure Code
